messages:
sam: Heads-up: cost dashboard shows negative cache savings for tenant t-301 after last canary :confused:
lee: saw it. looks like backfill and live prefetch both counted
anya: can you paste a quick repro (tenant, window, batch)?
sam: t-301, 2026-03-19 00:00-24:00, batch backfill-20260319
devin: root cause: rollup groups credits by type only. backfill emits "prefetch:backfill" so it doubles with live prefetch
lee: short-term: dedupe by (origin_id, request_sig) within 24h in rollup
anya: cautious: some flows get multiple legit credits. propose precedence: backfill < prefetch < rebate
sam: UI asks for explainability: add small provenance row when net cost < 0 listing top contributors
devin: backend API idea: /internal/cost-preview?tenant=t-301&window=24h&detail=provenance&counterfactual=prefetch -> numeric fields + provenance array
lee: make provenance opt-in (detail param) and limit to top 8 + others bucket to keep payload tiny
ops-bot: deploy job billing-rollup backfill-20260319 ran at 03:12 UTC; see https://ci.internal/reports/7002
devin: opened PR to dedupe credits and add debug dump: https://git.internal/p/r/redwood/billing/8301
anya: plan: hotfix rollup today, enable cost-preview v0.2 on canary for 1h, validate t-301/t-412, then full roll tomorrow if OK
sam: support blurb draft: "Duplicate prefetch credits from a backfill affected displayed cache-saving numbers; billing unaffected. Fix deployed."
lee: will monitor dashboards and post screenshots here
ops-bot: PR #8301 merged into canary (ci: green)
devin: canary looks clean for t-301, negatives gone. closing once prod roll scheduled.
